title: FoodRadar
subtitle: Food inventory & camera-assisted scanning
summary: A food inventory prototype built by a four-member team at BCS Hackathons, then expanded with UX refinements and authentication.

sections.title: My contribution
sections.body: I worked mainly on the backend during the hackathon as part of a four-member team. After the hackathon, I refined the user experience and added authentication.

sections.title: The experience
sections.body: Add and remove inventory items manually, or capture an image with a webcam to receive labels from Google Cloud Vision. The prototype also includes an Ask lookup flow.

sections.title: Full-stack implementation
sections.body: React and Chakra UI provide the interface, with Zustand for state management. Express and MongoDB handle backend data, with JWT and Google OAuth authentication.

sections.title: Prototype boundaries
sections.body: The webcam stands in for an intended fridge-mounted camera. Recognition depends on lighting and image clarity. Returned labels are not filtered specifically for food, so non-food objects may also be suggested.
